#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack quarterly_report.docx into a workspace and summarize paragraph styles."""
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
OUT = "unpacked"

Path(OUT).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
    zf.extractall(OUT)

# Pretty-print XML parts (mirrors the registered unpack helper, stdlib only)
for pattern in ("*.xml", "*.rels"):
    for xml_file in sorted(Path(OUT).rglob(pattern)):
        dom = minidom.parseString(xml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        xml_file.write_bytes(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="ascii"))

doc_path = Path(OUT) / "word" / "document.xml"
dom = minidom.parseString(doc_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
print(f"total paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pstyle = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
    style_val = pstyle[0].getAttribute("w:val") if pstyle else ""
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    if style_val:
        print(f"[{i}] style={style_val!r} text={txt[:80]!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Dump paragraph-level details from the unpacked document.xml."""
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

doc_path = Path("unpacked") / "word" / "document.xml"
dom = minidom.parseString(doc_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    runs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:r")
    info = []
    for r in runs:
        rpr = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        flags = []
        if rpr:
            e = rpr[0]
            for ch in e.childNodes:
                if ch.nodeType == ch.ELEMENT_NODE:
                    flags.append(ch.tagName.replace("w:", ""))
        texts = []
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
        info.append((rpr[0].toxml() if rpr else "", "".join(texts)))
    line = p.toxml()
    print(f"=== paragraph {i} (line: {p.lineNumber if hasattr(p, 'lineNumber') else 'n/a'}) ===")
    print(line[:1500])
    print()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headline paragraphs in unpacked/word/document.xml.

Headlines are all-caps section titles: non-empty paragraph text containing at
least one letter and no lowercase letters. Adds <w:u w:val="single"/> to the
run properties of every run in those paragraphs (appended after sz-cs per the
OOXML rPr element order).
"""
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

doc_path = Path("unpacked") / "word" / "document.xml"
dom = minidom.parseString(doc_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
changed = []

for p in paras:
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    txt = "".join(texts).strip()
    is_headline = bool(txt) and any(c.isalpha() for c in txt) and not any(c.islower() for c in txt)
    if not is_headline:
        continue
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if rprs:
            rpr = rprs[0]
            if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                u = dom.createElement("w:u")
                u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
                rpr.appendChild(u)
        else:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            u = dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
    changed.append(txt)

doc_path.write_bytes(dom.toxml(encoding="UTF-8"))
print("Underlined headline paragraphs (%d):" % len(changed))
for c in changed:
    print(" -", c)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack unpacked/ back into quarterly_report.docx (stdlib-only mirror of pack.py)."""
import shutil
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom


def condense(xml_file):
    """Strip whitespace-only text nodes and comments (mirrors pack.py condense_xml)."""
    with open(xml_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        dom = minidom.parse(f)
    for element in dom.getElementsByTagName("*"):
        if element.tagName.endswith(":t"):
            continue
        for child in list(element.childNodes):
            if (
                child.nodeType == child.TEXT_NODE
                and child.nodeValue
                and child.nodeValue.strip() == ""
            ) or child.nodeType == child.COMMENT_NODE:
                element.removeChild(child)
    with open(xml_file, "wb") as f:
        f.write(dom.toxml(encoding="UTF-8"))


input_dir = Path("unpacked")
output_file = Path("quarterly_report.docx")

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    temp_content = Path(td) / "content"
    shutil.copytree(input_dir, temp_content)
    for pattern in ("*.xml", "*.rels"):
        for xml_file in sorted(temp_content.rglob(pattern)):
            condense(xml_file)
    output_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output_file, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for f in sorted(temp_content.rglob("*")):
            if f.is_file():
                zf.write(f, f.relative_to(temp_content))

print("packed", output_file)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify quarterly_report.docx: integrity + underline coverage of headlines only."""
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

DOCX = "quarterly_report.docx"

# 1. Zip integrity
with zipfile.ZipFile(DOCX) as zf:
    bad = zf.testzip()
    names = zf.namelist()
    print("zip testzip:", "OK" if bad is None else ("CORRUPT: " + bad))
    print("parts:", len(names))
    xml = zf.read("word/document.xml")

# 2. Headline coverage
dom = minidom.parseString(xml)
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
headlines, extra_underlines = [], []

for p in paras:
    runs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:r")
    texts = []
    for r in runs:
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    txt = "".join(texts).strip()
    is_headline = bool(txt) and any(c.isalpha() for c in txt) and not any(c.islower() for c in txt)
    under_run_count = 0
    for r in runs:
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if rprs and rprs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
            us = rprs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u")
            if all(u.getAttribute("w:val") == "single" for u in us):
                under_run_count += 1
    if is_headline:
        status = "OK" if runs and under_run_count == len(runs) else "MISSING"
        headlines.append((txt, under_run_count, len(runs), status))
    elif under_run_count:
        extra_underlines.append((txt, under_run_count))

print("\nHeadlines:")
ok = True
for txt, n, total, status in headlines:
    print(f"  [{status}] {txt!r} ({n}/{total} runs underlined)")
    ok = ok and status == "OK"

print("\nNon-headline paragraphs containing underline:", len(extra_underlines))
for txt, n in extra_underlines:
    print("  !!", repr(txt), n)
    ok = False

print("\nRESULT:", "PASS" if ok and headlines else "FAIL")
